name: Infobeans Technologies Ltd
title: Infobeans Technologies Ltd - 543644 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Mid-size IT services firm reports 28% YoY revenue growth and 22% H1 growth ex-ERC, but no supply-side signal exists; the read is demand-led with rising receivables and no capacity or pricing data.

summary.headline: InfoBeans Q2 FY27 revenue rose 28% YoY to Rs 165 crore and PAT grew 16% YoY, with 6% QoQ revenue growth, the seventh straight quarter of sequential growth.
summary.overview: Management reported Q2 FY27 revenue of Rs 165 crore, up 28% YoY from Rs 129 crore, and up 6% QoQ; PAT rose 16% YoY and 21% QoQ to Rs 26 crore. Operating margin was about 24%, against a stated target of 24% and PAT margin of 14-15%. Excluding the prior-year H1 Employee Retention Credit (Rs 6.3 crore), H1 revenue grew 30% in INR and 22% in USD terms. The call also covered Claude Select Services partner status with Anthropic, a net addition of 43 employees on a base of about 1,800, and an M&A search with no deal announced.

financial_highlights.change: remainder of INR growth was rupee depreciation against INR
prior-year H1 included Rs 6.3 crore ERC (US govt. Employee Retention Credit), excluded from comparison
PAT margin ~16% in H1 as stated

financial_highlights.value: Dropped by about Rs 1-2 crore QoQ
financial_highlights.change: attributed to RBI rate hikes marking treasury bonds lower; management calls it notional as held to maturity
on base of 1,800+; management guided net addition of 10-15% for the year
management cited client payment delays, a shift to 60-90 day terms for some clients, and growth; provisions made

Verticals
segments.commentary: Multi-industry book including BFSI, manufacturing, logistics and HR; BFSI named as a strategic focus, with storage and virtualization as another vertical. Healthcare compliance was the only softness cited.

guidance_outlook: Long-run targets stated as 24% operating margin and 14-15% PAT margin; management said continued AI investment may pressure margins in future.
Net headcount addition guided at 10-15% for the year, with AI expected to improve efficiency and delivery optimisation.
Management does not give revenue forecasts but described a sustained momentum, healthy order pipeline and healthy demand.
M&A: active scouting for targets in AI and data and ServiceNow; leads received this quarter, no deal stage disclosed; acquisitions to be announced once a term sheet is signed.
Management stated the company is not focused on dividend yield; dividends and buybacks are made as and when needed.
capex_capacity: Capitalised about Rs 9 crore of intangible development cost for products Stanza and Beantrail; amortisation has started, per management.
Development centres in Indore, Pune, Chennai and Bengaluru; nearly 1,900 people in total, with fewer than 50 based outside India.
Investment in AI capability and in building out sales teams across geographies noted as a continuing cost item.
demand_pricing: Management reported no pricing pressure from clients and said the shift to outcome-based pricing has not reduced top-line; net headcount additions are lower than revenue growth.
Revenue growth was about 90% from existing clients and about 10% from new clients YoY; management said new-client relationships take 6-12 months to close large deals.
Claude Select Services partner status with Anthropic obtained two weeks before the call; a dozen certified cloud developers and a couple of deployed engineers; ISO 42001 certified for AI practices.
Core offerings are AI-led engineering, Salesforce and ServiceNow practices. Long client relationships cited: one client about 9 years, another 22-23 years, IQVIA 18 years.
Visa restrictions in the US: management said less than 50 of nearly 1,900 people are on US visas, so the impact is insignificant.
Management said it does not disclose individual deal sizes; two US and one India wins were mentioned via press release.

qa_highlights.question: How is the company devoting capacity to strong growth, and which industries are performing well?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said growth is spread across BFSI, manufacturing, logistics and HR with no single industry standing out; healthcare compliance was the only softness.

qa_highlights.question: How much net hiring was done and what are the plans?
qa_highlights.answer: Net addition of 43 in the quarter on a base of 1,800+ (about 2-3%); the year-level guidance is 10-15% net addition, with AI used to raise efficiency.

qa_highlights.question: Is pricing pressure seen from AI or outcome-based pricing?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said there is no pricing pressure and that outcome-based pricing has not hurt the top line; AI is also used internally to cut evaluation and appraisal cycles from weeks to days.

qa_highlights.question: Explain the Rs 9 crore capitalised intangibles and the director loan.
qa_highlights.answer: The Rs 9 crore relates to products Stanza and Beantrail, now amortising. The loan was a US employee-policy loan of up to USD 1 million to a director, interest-bearing, given for 3-4 months and repaid.

qa_highlights.question: Break-up of 22% constant-currency growth between existing and new clients?
qa_highlights.answer: About 90% from existing clients and about 10% from new clients; trust takes time and new deals typically take 6-12 months to close.

qa_highlights.question: Outlook, US concentration and visa risk?
qa_highlights.answer: Management aims to raise US share (49% now) and to expand the US sales team; visa restrictions have little impact since about 50 of nearly 1,900 people are on visas. Management declined to forecast.

qa_highlights.question: M&A update?
qa_highlights.answer: Scouting is active with strict criteria and several leads; no deal is at a closing stage, and the company will announce once a term sheet is signed.

risks_watch: Receivables increased; management cited delayed client payments and some shift to 60-90 day terms, and said provisions are held; collection pace to watch.
Treasury income fell by about Rs 1-2 crore QoQ because of rate-driven bond marks; management called it notional, but other income trends should be tracked.
Continued AI investment and sales expansion may pressure margins from the 24% target.
US concentration at 49% of revenue and US visa and macro uncertainty.
M&A pipeline with no disclosed deal; capital deployment and any acquisition announcement are open.
summary.management_tone: Confident and upbeat on growth and partnerships, with reluctance to give forecasts or disclose deal sizes. Management was more defensive on receivables and the director loan, and on M&A timing it stated only that efforts are ongoing.
key_quotes: we are not seeing any worry signs
we are not a visa dependent
it is just a notional loss for us

growth.why: No numeric revenue guidance; management cites sustained momentum and healthy order pipeline, with Q2 revenue up 28% YoY (about 22% in USD) and 90% of growth from existing clients, but no specific capacity or contracts are quantified behind it.
